subject: Security feature sprint gating and exception inventory
messages:
From: Rajiv Shah <r.shah@novamed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: sprint gating + retention/BYOK exceptions

Monica —

Thanks for the quick trial this week. Our compliance team ran through the service baseline and flagged three gating items we'd need clarified before we can sign off on the pilot expansion:

1) Audit log retention: Redwood's default 90-day retention is fine for most logs, but healthcare compliance requires a 7-year retention for certain event classes. We need to know options for storing those events long-term (export to customer-managed S3, or an export/evidence path we can control).

2) BYOK / KMS rotation windows: We rotate keys on a quarterly cadence. Does Redwood support scheduled key rollover windows so we can coordinate rotations without losing ingest?

3) SSO session audit fidelity: We need per-session SSO event export (login, token-issue, token-revoke) with deterministic timestamps. Can you confirm sampling policies and whether full streams are available for short-term escrow?

Our pilot expansion is gated to the Sprint-42 feature cut (target 2026-06-01). Can you triage and let me know what is feasible as exceptions vs roadmap items? I attached our compliance questionnaire for reference.

— Rajiv
Rajiv Shah
Security Manager, Novamed
security@novamed.com

Attachment: novamed_compliance_questions_v2.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Shah <r.shah@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sprint gating + retention/BYOK exceptions

Rajiv —

Thanks — this is clear and very actionable. We're happy to triage and propose a concrete path for Sprint-42. High-level answers:

- Retention: we can provide exports to a customer-managed S3 (signed, timeboxed exports) as a near-term exception; long-term native 7-year retention is a product ask and will require a roadmap slot.
- BYOK rotation: our Private/Dedicated flows support rotation scheduling today; for Hosted customers we can arrange a coordinated rotation window with the infra team as an exception.
- SSO audit fidelity: we do emit session events; full-stream exports are possible but currently sampled by default. We can enable full capture for scoped customers as an exception.

I'll loop in Marissa (product) for the implementation details and Ben (ops) for the maintenance window coordination. Can you confirm the specific event classes Novamed needs for 7-year retention (e.g., only API-write events, or auth/session events too)?

Next steps:
- I'll collect owners and map actions against Sprint-42 backlog by EOD tomorrow.
- If Novamed can share a minimal set of event types that require 7-year retention, we can give a more precise plan.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Product Program Manager — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Monica —

Thanks for the ping. Quick tech assessment below. I'm treating the ask as two parallel tracks: near-term (exceptions we can execute for the pilot) and product (roadmap changes).

Near-term (exceptions we can do before 2026-06-01):
- Daily filtered export to customer S3: Implementation plan is straightforward. Owner: Marissa (product) + Ben (ops). Effort: ~3 dev-days + 1 ops-day to configure transfer and lifecycle. Requirements from Novamed: destination S3 bucket ARN, credentials & IAM role for Redwoods to write, list of event types (JSON schema).
- BYOK rotation windows for Hosted pilot: Ops can schedule a maintenance window during which we'll accept rotated keys; we will coordinate a rye-slots schedule. Owner: Ben. Effort: 1 ops-day + runbook. Blocker: documented rotation policy from Novamed (timing + holdover key).
- SSO session events (full capture): We can flip their tenant to full-capture mode temporarily and stream to the export pipeline. Owner: Marissa. Effort: ~2 dev-days + 0.5 ops-day. Storage/cost: increased egress/storage; include this in the exception terms.

Product/roadmap (requires prioritization, not for Sprint-42):
- Native long-term retention (7 years) in-host: this needs product design, compliance review, cost model and legal signoff. Est: Q4 roadmap convo.
- Built-in BYOK orchestration UI for hosted customers: product item.

Immediate next steps:
1) Monica: confirm we have Novamed S3 details and minimal event-class list.
2) Ben: prepare a one-off maintenance slate with two candidate rotation windows (June 3 and June 10) and the ops runbook.
3) Marissa: produce a short config checklist for full-capture SSO and the export filter that will power the S3 writes.

I'll open SEC-421 and attach a short tech spec; we'll add the exception tasks under that ticket so we can track delivery.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Security Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: sprint gating + retention/BYOK exceptions — summary and next steps

Rajiv —

Thanks for the prompt follow-up and for preparing the questionnaire. To summarize what we've committed to for the Sprint-42 pilot:

1) Export-based retention exception: Redwood will perform daily filtered exports of the specified event classes to a Novamed-managed S3 bucket. That will satisfy the 7-year storage requirement for the scoped events while we evaluate a native long-term retention product path.

2) BYOK rotation windows: Ops will coordinate a scheduled rotation window (candidate dates: June 3 or June 10). During that window we will support your key rollover process and hold failing requests for a brief TTL to avoid data loss. We'll share the runbook prior to the window.

3) SSO session events: we'll enable full-capture for your tenant and stream those events into the export pipeline for the pilot. Expect increased storage/egress; we'll include a one-page cost estimate.

Required from Novamed: S3 bucket ARN + IAM role with write permissions, minimal event-class list (JSON schema), and preferred rotation date. Please send these by EOD May 26 to meet the test schedule.

I'll keep SEC-421 updated with progress and attach the evidence manifest after the first successful export. If anything changes on timing we will escalate internally.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Sr. Product Program Manager — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
